title: Nature World
description: A mod that adds variety to nature. Blocks, items, structures, biomes, etc. will be added to the mod. So keep an eye on the development of this mod, and see you soon!
body:
Hi! Do you want to diversify your natural world? Then this is the mod for you! This mod will add new content related to nature. Here is a part of the content: lakes in the savannah, mud in the swamp, sheaves of hay in the sunflower plain, fried spider eyes and fried rotten flesh, golden potatoes, pumpkin slices, and new trades with villagers. All of this awaits you in this mod!
 This mod will be updated, so don't miss out on the updates and enjoy the game! See you soon!
